title: Statistics graphs omit High and Low levels
symptom: The High and Low levels set under Settings, Glucose Units are visible as horizontal lines on the AGP graph, but it is not easy to see what those values are due to the large scale of the vertical axis. Neither of the other two statistical pages show those values.
fix: The issue has been addressed for the distribution graph, and the AGP graph will be addressed later.
evidence_quote: This has already been addressed for the distribution graph. What remains is the AGP graph. I will add that as well later.
